description: Shell library for working with 'chunk' files such as commit-graph and midx files. Defines a function 'corrupt_chunk_file' that corrupts a specified chunk within a file by overwriting bytes, supporting both partial corruption and complete chunk clearing.

methods.name: corrupt_chunk_file
methods.description: A shell function that corrupts a specific chunk in a file by invoking a Perl script to modify chunk bytes or clear the chunk.
